canonicalFactSet.statusLine: Worker A complete. Worker B is blocked on playback. No operator action required.
requiredFacts: Worker B is blocked on playback

candidates.intent: Conservative bedtime control; maximize comprehension and repetition tolerance.
candidates.hungerVerdict: Useful but under-seasoned; too close to pleasant sped-up utility speech. Keep as fallback reference, not the signature voice.

candidates.intent: Balanced signature: calm compressed Orandroid facts, one tiny over-polite She-Ra sting, then silence.
candidates.hungerVerdict: Best design-side safe candidate. The identity comes from contrast and restraint, not maximum squeak: long calm rail, tiny precise goblin cut, immediate return to silence.

exampleRoleTreatment.orandroid67: Worker A complete. Worker B is blocked on playback. No operator action required.
exampleRoleTreatment.sheRa: ... Playback, you very small administrative tragedy.

candidates.intent: Exploit pause contrast: shorter Orandroid packets, high but brief She-Ra with unusually spacious punctuation.
candidates.hungerVerdict: Strong bedtime challenger if punctuation actually yields useful space in Pocket TTS. Risk: pauseDensity may not map cleanly to audio without explicit text shaping.

candidates.intent: Hyperbolic edge probe; intentionally excessive to find the point where charm turns into chipmunk alarm.
candidates.hungerVerdict: Reject as a default. It discovers the useful boundary: She-Ra above roughly +8 semitones / 1.35x should be treated as an occasional diagnostic accent, not a standing bedtime voice.

designLastKnownGoodCandidate.reason: Highest combined truth, low-attention usefulness, recognizability, and non-generic delight without crossing into alarm-fatigue.

challenger.reason: Tests whether deliberate extra space can make a higher She-Ra pitch feel stranger and calmer rather than merely shriller.

implementationReadyProfile.promotionRule: Do not replace config LAST_KNOWN_GOOD_BASELINE until physical-phone playback evidence exists.

acceptIf: all three facts are immediately recoverable
She-Ra is recognizably distinct after one sentence
no urge to turn it off after two repetitions
Orandroid remains soothing enough for low-attention bedtime use
rejectIf: She-Ra sounds like generic anime/chipmunk TTS
roast competes with the factual status
the transition makes the update feel longer than the information warrants

designRationale: Hyperbolic testing shows maximum pitch/rate is not the signature. Contrast is the signature.
Orandroid should carry nearly all truth content; She-Ra should behave like punctuation with personality.
The weirdness budget is spent on one short role transition, not on continuous distortion.
No new DSP beyond the existing deterministic ffmpeg Nightcore transform is required for the first canary.
Punctuation-based transition cues are intentionally used so implementation can stay inside the current text + ffmpeg pipeline.
